parameters.help_en:
Identifies other message types for the subscribed product. The data format is JSON String.

If you subscribe to a JT/T 808 protocol cloud gateway product, you must specify SubscribeFlags with the following value:

    ```
    {
        "jt808DeviceDataFlag": true
    }
    ```

If you subscribe to device video stream status change notification messages, you must specify SubscribeFlags with the following value:

    ```
    {
        "lvDeviceStatusFlag": true
    }
    ```
    For more information about configuring AMQP server-side subscription for device video stream status change notification messages, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2698782.html.

If you subscribe to both of the above messages, use the following value:

    ```
    {
        "lvDeviceStatusFlag": true,
        "jt808DeviceDataFlag": true
    }
    ```
parameters.help_zh:
标识当前订阅产品的其他类型消息，数据格式为JSON String。

如果订阅的是JT/T 808协议云网关产品，必须传入SubscribeFlags，取值为：

    ```
    {
        "jt808DeviceDataFlag": true
    }
    ```

如果订阅的是设备视频流状态变更通知消息，必须传入SubscribeFlags，取值为：

    ```
    {
        "lvDeviceStatusFlag": true
    }
    ```
    配置AMQP服务端订阅设备视频流状态变更通知消息的详细内容，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2698782.html。

如果同时订阅以上消息，取值为：

    ```
    {
        "lvDeviceStatusFlag": true,
        "jt808DeviceDataFlag": true
    }
    ```
parameters.name: subscribe_flags

parameters.help_en:
The consumer group IDs in the AMQP subscription. This parameter is required when Type is set to AMQP.

After you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170388.html to create a consumer group, the consumer group ID is returned. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170419.html to query the consumer group ID by consumer group name, or view the consumer group ID in the IoT Platform console by choosing Message Forwarding > Server-side Subscription > Consumer Groups
parameters.help_zh:
创建的AMQP订阅中的消费组ID，Type为AMQP时必填。

调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170388.html创建消费组成功后，会返回消费组ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170419.html按消费组名称查询消费组ID，也可以在物联网平台控制台<props="china"><ph>对应实例下</ph></props>，选择消息转发>服务端订阅>消费组列表，查看消费组ID
